pane.title: 25%  fraction
pane.content:
This column is always a quarter of the body width.

Resize your terminal — every pane reflows from ratios, there is no fixed grid.

Try:
  ultui render examples/responsive.json 60x18
  ultui render examples/responsive.json 120x30
  ultui render examples/responsive.json 200x50

h / l  move focus
j / k  scroll a pane

pane.title: 30  fixed cells
pane.content:
This column holds 30 columns no matter the window size — good for a nav rail or a label gutter.

Fixed and percentage panes are laid out first; the flex (*) pane soaks up whatever is left, so the layout can never leave a gap or overflow the screen.

pane.title: flex  *  (fills the rest)
pane.command: printf '%s\n' 'This pane is the flex region.' '' 'It expands to fill whatever width and height' 'the fixed + percentage panes leave over.'
